matrix.title: Lug/pinhole engineering response
matrix.justification: T3 remains the registered fallback control; higher-order production routes carry the required lug response qualification. This allocation is frozen before B02 production observations.

matrix.title: Numerical verification and convergence
matrix.justification: Convergence evidence is required for each method across the qualified benchmark families where that method is applicable; B02E does not imply every method must be used for every B02D quantity.

rules: No matrix cell may be downgraded because an observed B02 result is inconvenient.
Any later EXCLUDED_WITH_JUSTIFICATION entry requires an explicit pre-observation expert decision and retained rationale.
Q4 remains research-only and is outside this production qualification matrix unless separately reviewed.
Production output may not generate or calibrate benchmark targets, tolerances, probes, mesh definitions or acceptance rules.
